title: Fellowship module config
description: The values the host stores and hands over through the settings port. The shapes and the defaults are owned by packages/core/src/config, which this file mirrors.

halfLifeDays.description: Half life of a contribution to a link score, in days. LinkStat.score is a cache of this, so a change triggers a full recompute before the new value counts as applied.

scoreScale.description: Multiplier applied before the clamp to -100..100. Same recompute hook as halfLifeDays.

avatarResolvers.description: Sources a profile picture may be fetched from, in the order they are tried. Templates are https only, carry no credentials, and must contain a placeholder.

chatThresholds.description: Sample sizes below which a chat figure is reported as insufficient rather than guessed at.

messageChunk.description: Rows per batch when storing or importing messages. 500 across 8 columns binds 4000 parameters, well under SQLite's ceiling.
